gate_rules: T2 debt needs why/exit, exemptions need why
T3 debt must still be accurate
T4 boards agree with the declared toolchains

aarch64-linux.assert: no SIMD mnemonics in our objects

armv7hf-linux.assert: readelf -A reports Tag_FP_arch: VFPv4 and Advanced SIMD with Fused-MAC

variants._note: a variant is a compile-option cell on an existing board, not a new board; each one must prove its flag reached the artifact (check_artifact), so 'it compiled and passed' cannot stand in for 'the capability is covered'
